mode: actual standalone HTML injected into about:blank
checks: Default differential experiment is the single relation map, with true and false arrows distinguished
Property definition explicitly distinguishes existence in a neighbourhood from continuity at the origin
Predictions reveal the authored four-node truth table without treating samples as proof
All four smooth positive examples are selectable and changing example resets the reveal
Graph arrows are keyboard-operable and navigate to the corresponding explanation/experiment
True-arrow explanation unfolds a uniform epsilon-delta proof rather than a list of observations
Guided path visits all three implications before explicitly attempting the inverse on a smooth example
Differentiability without continuous partials uses analytic -1/+1 sequences and a uniform vanishing remainder bound
Neighbourhood partial existence versus discontinuity: axes, diagonal, both sides and punctured origin are distinct
The discontinuity example exposes unbounded nearby partials, not a violation of the bounded-partials theorem
Continuous cusp has genuinely undefined partials, disabled derivative plane and explicitly labelled reference height
CSV exports undefined derivative quantities as blank rather than zero, with finite-sampling provenance
Original counterexample still establishes that continuity and both partials together do not imply differentiability
The textbook conditional arrow is present and refuses an example that lacks bounded partials
A false antecedent does not turn a theorem red or falsely force its conclusion to fail
Three-dimensional surface camera supports keyboard rotation and exact reset
Explicit approach animation advances and pauses without replacing the focused input
Deep links restore example, arrow, observation view, direction, metric and scale but no student answers
Shared link fallback works in a browser without clipboard permission
All three unseen-function challenges validate four properties plus a reason and unfold substantive proofs
Incorrect classifications and reasons are reported separately; drafts survive exploration without leaking to URLs
Map, cases, long proofs and assessments have no document overflow at 360/390/768/1024 pixels
Mobile uses a readable directed tree and touchable inverse arrows rather than shrinking the desktop map
Switching between relation lab, limits and field lab cleans up controllers and keeps existing experiments available
Malformed relation routes are rejected or clamped in the live app
Reset clears relation state and session prediction drafts
All exercised controls are named, no uncaught JS errors, and no external runtime requests
notes: Numerical checks validate implementation consistency, not general theorems.
Clipboard denial and Blob construction tested; native OS saving not assumed.
No Safari, Firefox or full screen-reader audit.
